title: Alarm
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (tiny bell + silver wire)
text | Wards a 20-foot cube within range against intrusion.
text | When a Small or larger creature enters the area, the alarm triggers: choose an audible sound (within 60 ft) or a mental ping (if within 1 mile).
text | You can designate creatures to bypass the alarm.

title: Cure Wounds
contents: text | You touch a creature and restore 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points.
text | The spell has no effect on constructs or undead.
text | Healing increases at higher levels as shown below.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Alarm
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (tiny bell + silver wire)
text | Choose audible or mental alert when a Tiny+ creature enters.
text | You can exclude creatures from triggering the alarm.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Detect Magic
contents: text | For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 ft of you.
text | You see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic.
text | You learn the school of magic, if any.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Disguise Self
contents: text | You make yourself — including clothing, armor, weapons, and gear — look different until the spell ends.
text | You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and appear thin, fat, or in between.
text | The changes are purely visual and don't hold up to physical inspection.
text | A creature can use an Action to inspect you, succeeding with an Investigation check against your spell save DC to reveal the illusion.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Expeditious Retreat
contents: text | When you cast this spell, and then on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.
text | This burst of speed lets you move swiftly through the battlefield or escape danger with ease.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Faerie Fire
contents: text | Each creature in a 20-ft cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice) if it fails a Dexterity saving throw.
text | For the duration, affected creatures:
bullet | Grant Advantage on attack rolls made against them.
text | Objects in the area are also outlined if not worn or carried.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: False Life
contents: text | You gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.
text | When cast using a higher-level spell slot, increase the bonus by +5 per level above 1st, as shown below.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Feather Fall
contents: text | Choose up to five falling creatures within range.
text | Their descent slows to 60 ft/round.
text | They take no falling damage and land on their feet.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Grease
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (bit of pork rind)
text | You create a slick of grease covering a 10-foot square area centered on a point within range.
text | The area becomes difficult terrain for the duration.
text | When the grease appears, each creature standing in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.
text | A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on the saving throw or fall prone.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Identify
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a pearl of 100 gp + owl feather)
text | You touch a magic item and learn its properties, how to use them, and whether it requires attunement.
text | If the item has charges, you learn how many it has remaining. If it's cursed, you sense the presence of the curse (but not its exact effects).
text | Alternatively, you can identify the spell affecting a creature or object, if it's under the effect of one.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Jump
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a leg from a grasshopper)
text | You touch a creature, and for the duration, its jump distance is tripled.
text | This applies to both long and high jumps, following standard jump rules.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Longstrider
contents: text | You touch a creature, and its base walking speed increases by 10 ft for the duration.
text | The effect doesn't stack with itself but can be recast after the hour ends.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Purify Food and Drink
contents: text | You purify all non-magical food and drink within a 5-ft cube centered within range.
text | The affected items are cleansed of all poisons and diseases, making them safe for consumption.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1

title: Sanctuary
contents: text | You ward a creature within range against enemy attacks.
text | Any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw.
text | On a failed save, the attacker must choose a new target or lose the attack/spell.
text | The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack or casts a spell that affects an enemy.
footer | Artificer | Spell Level 1 | Artificer Level 1
